pr_title: *:Speed up parse slow-log when query slow_query #15371
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close [#15354](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/15371)

Problem Summary:
After Issue #15354 laster, the performance improvement is not significant. The Read slow log file and parse process are slow.

### What is changed and how it works?
What's Changed:
In the slow log query process, the two steps of reading the log and parsing the log have been serialized. Here, the step of parsing the log is put into the go routine to make it concurrent. 

For query 300M tidb-slow.log:
-- before this PR;
![251597216170_ pic](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38248129/89985885-45b2fe00-dcae-11ea-8441-a2a3acc5c966.jpg)
Spend 4.75s

-- this PR;
![261597216224_ pic](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/38248129/89985944-5f544580-dcae-11ea-8b8b-67a27ab57aa5.jpg)
Spend 1.25-1.30s

**Improve slow log query efficiency by 4 times.**

How it Works:
the step of parsing the log is put into the go routine to make it concurrent. 

### Related changes

- PR to update `pingcap/tidb/executor/slow_query.go`:
- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Manual test

Side effects

- Performance regression
  - **Improve slow log query efficiency by 4 times**

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->
- Speed up parse slow-log when query slow_query.

issue_context.body:
## Description

After Issue https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/15354 laster, I found the performance improvement is not significant. The Read slow log file and parse process are slow.

So, we still need to speed up it.
 
## Score

Use a bench test to judge the score, the bench test should in the below situation:

* compare the time cost of `select count(*) from information_schema.slow_query`
*  And the `slow-log.log` file is 300M.
* Should do bench test in NVME or SSD.

Below is the score: 

* improve 10X -1000
* improve 9X -900
* improve 8X -800
......
* improve 2X -200

At least has 2x performance improvement, the max score is 1000.
